grammarFocus: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查。
title: The Community Pool Project: Reading and Understanding Data
instructions: 阅读以下关于社区游泳池项目的短文，然后回答10个问题。文章和问题均为模拟材料，用于英语学习，并非官方雅思考试。请仔细阅读，注意比较结构、数量表达和指代，以及冠词和主谓一致。
passage:
Last year, the town of Riverton decided to build a new community swimming pool. The local council asked a group of volunteers to collect data about how often residents used the old pool and what they wanted from a new one. The volunteers surveyed 500 people over three months. Their findings were surprising.

A. The survey showed that 60% of residents used the old pool at least once a week in summer, but only 15% used it in winter. The most common reason for not swimming in winter was the cold water. The old pool had no heating system. In contrast, the new pool will have solar heating, so it can stay open all year. The volunteers also found that families with children were more likely to swim regularly than people without children. Among families with children, 75% swam at least once a week in summer, compared with 45% of people without children. This difference was even larger in winter: 30% of families with children swam weekly, compared with just 10% of people without children.

B. The council also looked at the cost. The old pool cost $200,000 a year to run, but it was often overcrowded in summer and empty in winter. The new pool will cost $350,000 a year to run, but it will be open all year and will have more facilities, such as a gym and a cafe. The council believes that the extra cost is worth it because more people will use the pool. They predict that 80% of residents will use the new pool at least once a month. In addition, the new pool will create 15 new jobs for local people.

C. However, not everyone is happy. Some residents think that the money should be spent on other things, like repairing roads. They argue that the new pool is a luxury, not a necessity. The council responded that the pool is important for community health and that the survey showed strong support for it. In fact, 70% of the people surveyed said they would use the new pool if it had better facilities. The council will make a final decision next month.

D. The volunteers learned an important lesson about data. At first, they were confused because the numbers seemed to contradict each other. For example, the old pool was busy in summer but empty in winter, and the cost was high but the income was low. They realized that they needed to look at the data more carefully. They compared summer and winter usage, and they looked at different groups of people. They also checked for errors in their survey. In the end, they understood that the data told a clear story: the old pool was not meeting the community's needs, and a new pool with better facilities could attract more users all year round.

E. The volunteers also compared their data with data from other towns. They found that towns with heated pools had higher year-round usage. For instance, a nearby town with a heated pool reported that 65% of residents used it at least once a month in winter. This supported the idea that heating is important. The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and the council used the data to make its decision. The new pool project was approved, and construction will start next spring. The volunteers felt proud that their careful analysis had helped the community. They also recommended that the council continue to collect data after the new pool opens, so that they can measure its success and make further improvements if needed.

grammar.title: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查
grammar.explanation: 本课重点复习比较结构（如 more likely than, compared with）、数量表达（如 60% of residents, at least once a week）以及指代（如 they, it）的用法。同时注意冠词（a/an/the）和主谓一致（如 the number of... is, 60% of residents are）。在阅读时，注意这些结构如何帮助表达数据和比较。
grammar.example: families with children were more likely to swim regularly than people without children

options: The number of residents who use the pool is increasing.
The number of residents who use the pool are increasing.
A number of residents who use the pool is increasing.
The number of residents who uses the pool are increasing.
answers: The number of residents who use the pool is increasing.
questions.explanation: “the number of”作主语时，谓语动词用单数（is）；而“a number of”作主语时，谓语用复数。这里“the number of residents”是单数概念。

options: 60% of the residents supports the new pool.
60% of the residents support the new pool.
60% of the residents is supporting the new pool.
60% of the residents has supported the new pool.
answers: 60% of the residents support the new pool.
questions.explanation: “60% of + 复数名词”作主语时，谓语动词用复数形式（support）。

options: The old pool was more crowded than the new pool will be.
The old pool was more crowded that the new pool will be.
The old pool was most crowded than the new pool will be.
The old pool was crowdeder than the new pool will be.
answers: The old pool was more crowded than the new pool will be.
questions.explanation: 比较级用“more + 形容词 + than”结构，crowded的比较级是more crowded。

options: The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and it used the data to make its decision.
The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and they used the data to make its decision.
The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and he used the data to make its decision.
The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and them used the data to make its decision.
answers: The volunteers presented their findings to the council, and it used the data to make its decision.
questions.explanation: 这里“it”指代“the council”（单数机构），所以用it；their指代volunteers。
